content.short: API platform that lets Latin American fintechs add crypto, brokerage, QR payments and ramps.
content.description: Manteca sells its infrastructure as APIs. Fintechs can offer crypto buying, selling and custody, a brokerage with access to Argentina's MEP dollar, CEDEARs, bonds and funds, and fiat-to-crypto ramps. Its payments API connects to QR systems across the region, including PIX in Brazil, Yape in Peru and Bre-b in Colombia, and it adds bill payments in several countries.
content.meta: Manteca's APIs give LATAM fintechs crypto, brokerage, QR payments like PIX and Yape, ramps and bill pay.
